parent.champion: five learner DIRECT blend plus frozen causal P50 hinge

hypothesis: A fixed reduction of the POS contribution on rows with large disagreement from the frozen four learner R06 baseline can outperform both the unchanged champion and a same-cycle uniform shrink control. This is not a learned reliability estimator.

source_contract.pos_raw: Original full-cycle POS raw auxiliary output from the frozen original POS model.
source_contract.pos_t50: Apply the unchanged same-cycle T50 mapping to the original POS raw output before selection or blending.
source_contract.baseline: Frozen R06 four learner OOF baseline for the same physical row.
source_contract.labels: No query labels may be read before candidate prediction freeze and independent prelabel QA.

scales.statistic: Median of strictly positive absolute POS T50 minus R06 disagreements on present selection rows.
scales.unsupported_behavior: If support is below 200, mark the scale unsupported and use the exact champion policy for that window.

policies.REAL: w_i = 0.25 * exp(-abs(p_i-b_i)/s); present DIRECT = clip(b_i + w_i*(p_i-b_i), 0, 100).
policies.CONTROL: For each query cycle, use the mean REAL weight among present rows in that same cycle as a constant weight for present rows in the cycle.
policies.missing: Every policy returns the exact R06 baseline on missing rows.
policies.hinges: Apply the same already frozen causal D1/D2 hinge to all policies; never apply the final all OOF hinge to the pilot windows.

evaluation.primary: Unique D1 plus D2 rows, expected total 15953.
evaluation.disclosure: Development labels have been used repeatedly. D1 and D2 are distinct score rows but not independent validation; E75 training includes earlier D1 cycles.
evaluation.group_support: Use inherited REG groups and n>=100; unsupported groups remain UNKNOWN.
evaluation.scientific_gate: REAL pooled MAE gain >= 0.02; D1 and D2 gains >= 0; REAL gain over CONTROL > 0; required groups supported; maximum supported REAL group harm <= 0.25; exact missing fallback; independent QA PASS.
evaluation.exploratory_gate: (REAL pooled gain > 0 OR (D2 gain >= 0.01 AND pooled gain >= -0.01)); D1 gain >= -0.05; required groups supported; maximum supported REAL group harm <= 0.25; exact missing fallback; independent QA PASS.
evaluation.selection: No label-based selection of scale, lambda, policy, or control after scoring. Never promote CONTROL after seeing results.

final_source: Only after independent metric QA and exploratory eligibility, write the unique target-free OOF disagreement source (E67 cycles 68-75 plus E75 cycles 76-79); do not fit its final scale or run E79 before root review.
